prompt:
Find real studies or official reports on how much electricity Bitcoin mining consumed in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures they give.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the search results, several reports and studies provide estimates for Bitcoin mining electricity consumption relevant to 2025, either through direct measurement in early 2025 or annualized projections based on mid-2024 data.

The Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index (CBECI), cited in a February 2025 report, provides a specific snapshot of annualized consumption at that time. Additionally, the Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance (CCAF) released a report in April 2025 estimating annual usage based on survey data from firms representing nearly half the network's hashrate. Other industry reports from late 2025 also provide instantaneous power demand figures which can be contextualized against annual consumption metrics.

SOURCE: https://www.cigionline.org/static/documents/Emerging_Digital_Assets_Forrest.pdf | QUOTE: "As reported by CBECI in February 2025, bitcoin’s network power demand and annualized consumption were 20.01 gigawatt and 175.44 terawatt-hours (TWh), respectively." | CLAIM: The CBECI estimated Bitcoin's annualized electricity consumption to be 175.44 TWh as of February 2025.

SOURCE: https://www.jbs.cam.ac.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/2025-04-cambridge-digital-mining-industry-report.pdf | QUOTE: "Annualised electricity consumption associable with Bitcoin mining is estimated at 138 TWh, representing a YoY increase of 17% and approximately 0.54% of global electricity consumption." | CLAIM: A CCAF study published in April 2025 estimated Bitcoin's annual electricity consumption at 138 TWh, based on data up to June 2024.

SOURCE: https://institutional.gomining.com/docs/institutional-gomining-q3-2025-report.pdf | QUOTE: "network at 23.19 gigawatts (GW). Hashrate Index estimates a total consumption of 21.5 GW." | CLAIM: In the third quarter of 2025, the Hashrate Index estimated Bitcoin's total power consumption at 21.5 GW, while another metric placed it at 23.19 GW.

SOURCE: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-58287-3 | QUOTE: "From mid-2022 to mid-2023, the 34 mines consumed 32.3 terawatt-hours of electricity—33% more than Los Angeles—85% of which came from fossil fuels." | CLAIM: A study published in March 2025 analyzed historical data from mid-2022 to mid-2023, finding that 34 large US mines consumed 32.3 TWh during that period, though it does not provide a total global figure for 2025.
